bandReport.notes:
Band covers Q1-Q60 contiguously across p00-p07 (printed pages 2-A, 4-A, 6-A, 8-A, 10-A, 12-A, 14-A, 16-A — the booklet is bilingual, so printed page numbers advance by two and the render has already dropped the Hindi pages). Booklet code BLS-S-FDE.

Per-page counts: p00 Q1-8 (8), p01 Q9-15 (7), p02 Q16-23 (8), p03 Q24-30 (7), p04 Q31-38 (8), p05 Q39-45 (7), p06 Q46-53 (8), p07 Q54-60 (7).

DIRECTIONS SETS: NONE. There is no 'Directions:' block and no 'Consider the following for the next N items' block anywhere in p00-p07, so no setLabel/context is used in this band. THREE questions look set-like and are not — each is a single self-contained question whose own options follow immediately: Q4 and Q46 open 'Consider the following statements :' with numbered items 1. and 2.; Q53 opens 'Consider the following distribution :' and Q58 'Consider the following frequency distribution :', each carrying one table used by that question alone (so per the brief the table goes in the stem, not in context).

SEAM CHECK: there is no page before p00 — the render starts at Q1, which is complete with its four options on p00. I opened p08 (band b2's first page, printed 18-A) WITHOUT transcribing it: it opens cleanly at Q61 ('If x sin theta = y cos theta = 2z tan theta / (1 - tan^2 theta), then what is 4z^2(x^2+y^2) equal to?') with its full option block, and its right column opens at Q65. So nothing straddles the p07/p08 boundary, no question is stranded between the bands, and no Directions block starts on p07 and runs into p08. My last question, Q60, is complete on p07 with all four options printed.

FIGURES: NONE in this band. No question in Q1-Q60 refers to a printed diagram, and no diagram is printed on p00-p07. Q54 is the one that might be mistaken for a figure question — it says 'In a pie diagram, there are four slices with angles 150, 90, 60 and 60' — but NO pie chart is drawn on the page; every angle the question needs is stated in words, so it is answerable from the stem alone and hasFigure is correctly absent. Q53, Q57 and Q58 carry printed DATA TABLES (not figures); all three are transcribed inline as GFM pipe tables with separator rows.

RAISED MIDDLE DOT: every occurrence in this band is a DECIMAL POINT, checked individually at zoom — Q1 (0.064, 6.25, 0.081, 4.84), Q5 (0.35, 0.70, 2.25, 0.19), Q6 (log 2 = 0.301), and the Q57 table (1.00, 1.50, 2.00) plus its 'average price per pencil is Rs. 1.25'. All transcribed as full stops per the brief. No multiplication dot and no time separator occurs in p00-p07.

RUPEE GLYPH: the booklet prints the rupee sign in Q22, Q26, Q34, Q37, Q40, Q57 (both column headers and all four options). Transcribed as 'Rs.' per the corpus convention (verified against the shipped 2018-1/2018-2/2019-1/2019-2 band files, which use 'Rs.' and never the Unicode glyph).

ITALIC ELL (Q56): the stem's odd-number list is 'j, k, l, m, n' and option (b) is '(5l + 7d)/4', where the fourth letter is a typeset ITALIC ell, not the digit 1 — confirmed at 4.5x against the upright '1' elsewhere on the same page. Transcribed as the letter l.

GLYPHS CHECKED AT HIGH ZOOM (each was ambiguous at page resolution and is now settled): Q38's relation reads as a clean two-bar '=' at 9x — what looks like a third bar at page scale is an ink speck below the glyph, so it is NOT an approximation sign. Q21's 'which' is faded in the scan but legible at 5x, and the small '0' floating to its right is a stray pencil/scan artefact, not printed text. Q43's radical carries index 3 (cube root) over the mixed number 4 12/125. Q48's exponent is p-1. Q41's options were read letter by letter at 4.5x and 7x because (a)-(d) differ only by signs and a leading x.

NO MISPRINTS FOUND. Nothing in p00-p07 required a flags entry for a printed defect, and nothing was illegible. The single flags entry in this band (Q12) is NOT a misprint report — it records that the asymmetric exponent placement in (3A^2 + 4B)/(3A - 4B^2) was verified at 5x and is exactly what the page prints, so that a later pass does not 'repair' it into a symmetric expression.

INVENTED SUBTOPICS: NONE. Every chapter and subtopic used is a literal key/value from catalog.json.

CLASSIFICATION NOTES worth a second eye: Q43 (cube root of the mixed number 4 12/125) is filed under Surds, Indices and Simplification / 'Simplification of Expressions'; Number System / 'Perfect Squares and Cubes' is an equally defensible home and was the runner-up. Q44 (policeman chasing a thief with a 100 m head start) is filed under Time, Speed and Distance / 'Time, Speed and Distance' rather than 'Races', since 'Races' in this catalog is the A-gives-B-a-start shape that Q23 already occupies. Q49 (ratio 1:5, product 320, difference of squares) is filed under Ratio, Proportion and Variation / 'Ratio and Proportion'; Number System / 'Difference of Squares and Factor Pairs' was the runner-up.
